output.explanation: Expanded call-core-render vertically: its central diagram now emphasizes event-loop dispatch and shared draw entry, with two peripherals detailing snapshot/cell preparation and GPU submission/completion. Left call-core and call-core-pty unchanged because they already trace their respective activation paths; this pass deepens renderer calls rather than adding peer responsibilities. Checked the pinned checkout's renderer, terminal render state, backend completion, Surface/App delivery, search flag and PTY mutex hand-off paths. Clarified visibility-regain ordering, the nested draw lock during Kitty snapshot updates, and that synchronized output skips snapshot replacement but does not bypass the caller's draw attempt. Corrected the overly broad synchronous-presentation description: Metal distinguishes synchronous/asynchronous completion, while OpenGL ignores the sync argument and exports finished frames for runtime presentation. Preserved every existing edge, relocating endpoints where details moved, and added peripheral call and shared-state connections.
